title: ArkGate field gap assertions (maintainer dogfood)
against: mother arkgate 4.1.0+ (local bin/ + dist/), not npm latest unless pinned
description: Offline-first gap locks. Prefer unit fixtures already in tests/; soft-skip when a feature slice has not landed.

assertions.evidence: tests/unit/eslint/parity.test.ts — type-only import still flags, ok:true, failsStrict:false
productHonesty.finished false when active blocking violations or mode adapt with residual; type-only excluded from blocking
productHonesty unfinished with red graph / adapt residual unless whole-tree green + zero smells + zero blocking
cd apps/web finds monorepo ark.config via walk-up; write paths stay on --root unless --follow-config-root
SPA preset, adopt heuristics, migrate-contract, start confidence gate
force preserve customized AGENTS content-identity + managed digest recompute
resolveImportSpecifier @/* + ESLint rule fire + CLI dual-driver on same fixture
templates/skills ark-explore + ark-fix Plan B one-pilot checklist
design-weak-enforce: empty plan A + productHonesty unfinished + postGreenPath clarify-for-ai
finished false when honesty reasons present (design-weak, coverage, dual-truth, dirty freeze)

labRerun.note: Full 7-repo network lab is manual / nightly only — not required for CI smoke.
